name: Capital One Spark Cash for Business

localized_names.en: Capital One Spark Cash for Business

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Introductory $0 annual fee for the first year; $95 after that.

apr.notes: 24.49% variable APR on purchases, per the product page.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

credit_required.notes: Excellent credit indicated on the product page.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase, everywhere, no limits or category restrictions.

categories.label: Hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash back through a statement credit or check via your Capital One Business account.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $1,000 cash bonus when you spend $10,000 in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

benefits.title: Free Employee Cards
benefits.description: Track employee spending while earning all the rewards from their purchases.

benefits.title: Virtual Card Numbers
benefits.description: Make safer payments online without exposing your actual card number with merchants.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Get free additional warranty and protection on eligible items you purchase with your card.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: Business cards offer services to help during auto-related emergencies, such as jump-starting, tire changing and towing.

benefits.title: Year-End Summaries
benefits.description: Get an itemized report of your spending to simplify budgeting and tax time.

benefits.title: Capital One Business Travel
benefits.description: Complimentary access to an all-in-one business travel management solution.

notes: Verified against the official Capital One product page on 2026-07-26. Also marketed as 'Spark 2% Cash'. Earns unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase plus 5% cash back on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel. Introductory $0 annual fee for the first year, then $95. Business (small-business) card; segment set to 'business'.
